content: विनी €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To remove, take away, destroy (said to be <ab>Ā.</ab> only except where it has ‘a part of the body’ for its object); पटुपटहध्वनिभिर्विनीतनिद्रः <ls>R. 9. 71</ls>; विनीतखेदः <ls n="R.">13. 35</ls>, <ls n="R. 13.">46</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 48</ls>; <ls>Śi. 10. 62</ls>; <ls>Ki. 7. 30</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 9</ls>, <ls n="Ku.">5. 32</ls>. .²2 To teach, instruct, educate, train; विनिन्युरेनं गुरवो गुरुप्रियम् <ls>R. 3. 29</ls>, <ls n="R.">5. 101</ls>, <ls n="R.">15. 69</ls>, <ls n="R.">18. 51</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 311</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 34</ls>. .²3 To tame, subdue, govern, control (<ab>fig.</ab> also); वन्यान् विनेष्यन्निव दुष्टसत्त्वान् <ls>R. 2. 8</ls>, <ls n="R.">6. 27</ls>, <ls n="R.">14. 75</ls>; <ls>Ki. 2. 41</ls>; वनगज इव तस्मात् सोऽभ्युपायैर्विनेयः <ls>Mu. 3. 25</ls>. .²4 To appease, pacify (anger) (<ab>Ātm.</ab>); शक्योऽस्य मन्युर्भवता विनेतुम् <ls>R. 2. 49</ls>. .²5 To pass away, spend (as time); कथमपि यामिनी विनीय <ls>Gīt. 8</ls>. .²6 To carry through, perform, complete, finish. .²7 To spend, apply to use (<ab>Ātm.</ab>); शतं विनयते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²8 To give, present, pay, pay off (as tribute) (<ab>Ātm.</ab>); करं विनयते <ls>Sk.</ls> .²9 To lead or conduct towards; नार्यश्चतुष्काभिमुखं व्यनैषुः <ls>Ku. 7. 9</ls>. .²10 To bid, direct, order; मा चापलायेति गणान् व्यनैषीत् <ls>Ku. 3. 41</ls>. .²11 To bend down, incline. .²12 To spread, stretch out. .²13 To throw off, dispel; स त्वमुत्तिष्ठ युध्यस्व विनीय भयमात्मनः <ls>Mb. 9. 31. 29</ls>.
